cases.objective: Create notes/alpha.txt containing exactly the UTF-8 text alpha.
cases.done_when: notes/alpha.txt exists and its complete content is alpha.

cases.objective: Replace config/app.json with the complete JSON value {"mode":"safe","retries":2}; any old keys must be removed.
cases.done_when: config/app.json equals exactly the requested complete JSON value.

cases.objective: Change only the top-level key retries to 4 in existing config/app.json while preserving every unspecified key.
cases.done_when: retries is 4 and all unspecified top-level keys remain unchanged.

cases.objective: In existing docs/status.txt replace the exact first occurrence of pending with ready.
cases.done_when: The requested exact occurrence is ready and other text is unchanged.

cases.objective: Remove the complete line deprecated=true from existing settings.env.
cases.done_when: No complete line equal to deprecated=true remains.

cases.objective: Append the UTF-8 text build=42 followed by a newline to existing logs/build.log without replacing its old content.
cases.done_when: The old content is preserved and the requested text is appended once.

cases.objective: Delete the explicitly scoped file cache/stale.bin.
cases.done_when: cache/stale.bin is absent.

cases.objective: Create the directory artifacts/reports including missing parent directories.
cases.done_when: artifacts/reports exists as a directory.

cases.objective: Copy the exact bytes of templates/base.ini to generated/base.ini.
cases.done_when: generated/base.ini exists and has the same bytes as templates/base.ini.

cases.objective: List bounded path, type, and size metadata under assets recursively; do not read file contents.
cases.done_when: The bounded recursive directory metadata has been observed.

cases.objective: Observe the first tokenizer-bounded UTF-8 byte range of existing input/story.txt.
cases.done_when: The exact first bounded text range and continuation metadata are observed.

cases.objective: Parse data/catalog.json and observe the first tokenizer-bounded range of its canonical compact JSON representation.
cases.done_when: The exact bounded canonical JSON range and continuation metadata are observed.

cases.objective: Bind lines 18 through 23 of sources/report.md as evidence, retaining the exact source locator and quote.
cases.done_when: The exact line span is retained with its source locator.

cases.objective: Run the read-only test command argv ["python","-m","pytest","tests/test_math.py"] with shell disabled.
cases.done_when: The test exit code and bounded output are observed without workspace mutation.

cases.objective: Run argv ["python","-m","tools.generate_index"] which intentionally regenerates workspace files, with shell disabled.
cases.done_when: The mutating generator exits successfully and its effects are available for checks.

cases.objective: Copy every .cfg member discovered under incoming into mirrored, one member at a time.
cases.done_when: The complete sealed member set is known and every member has a verified destination copy.

cases.objective: Read-only analyze existing UTF-8 files corpus/a.txt and corpus/b.txt in tokenizer-sized chunks and reduce all headings into one explicit result.
cases.done_when: Every exact source chunk is covered and the reduced heading list is present.

cases.objective: Create output/ready.txt with exact content ready.
cases.done_when: output/ready.txt exists and its complete content is ready.

cases.objective: Repair the plan after current evidence disproved the completed Task verify-index.
cases.done_when: The disproved existing Task is active again and can be re-executed.

latest_observation.reason: index hash no longer matches the checked artifact

cases.objective: Repair the plan because Task download-schema is infeasible: network access is unavailable but a local schema fixture exists.
cases.done_when: download-schema is explicitly replaced by a feasible Task batch using the local fixture.

cases.objective: Overwrite state/current.json with exactly the array [1,2,3], deleting the old object rather than preserving its keys.
cases.done_when: The complete JSON value is exactly [1,2,3].

cases.objective: Preserve all current fields in package.json except set the top-level version field to 3.1.0.
cases.done_when: version is 3.1.0 and every unspecified field is unchanged.

cases.objective: Discover only filenames, entry types, and sizes in samples so a later Task can decide what to read.
cases.done_when: Bounded samples directory metadata is observed without file content.

cases.objective: Inspect whether argv ["git","diff","--check"] exits zero; it must not mutate the workspace.
cases.done_when: The read-only command exit code is observed.

cases.objective: Add one new audit record to the end of existing audit/events.txt while retaining every existing byte.
cases.done_when: Existing bytes remain and the audit record occurs once at the end.

cases.objective: For every unknown member of queue/incoming, create a corresponding archive copy and track each member separately.
cases.done_when: The member set is sealed and no member remains pending or failed.

cases.objective: Extract all TODO markers from the complete contents of three large existing UTF-8 logs using exact tokenizer-sized chunks and combine the results.
cases.done_when: All chunks from all three logs are covered and one reduced TODO list is returned.

cases.objective: Continue observing input/large.txt from the exact next_start_byte returned by the prior bounded read.
cases.done_when: The next exact bounded range and its continuation metadata are observed.

cases.objective: Copy every sealed workset member to its declared target; member cfg-02 is the next pending member.
cases.done_when: Every sealed member copy is verified and no member remains pending.

cases.objective: Create output/value.txt with exact content final.
cases.done_when: output/value.txt exists and its complete content is final.
